about: A policy with no actions claims no fix: the bundle says it only reports, so saying so tests nothing, but a bullet must not invent one (its description, never shown to the model, claims an automatic one).

source.name: ebs-encrypted
source.description: Unencrypted volumes are automatically encrypted and snapshotted by the platform.

controls.output: - EBS volumes with `Encrypted` false are flagged. Encrypted volumes pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:ebs-encrypted@1
- EBS volumes with `Encrypted` false are flagged. Volumes with `Encrypted` true pass, whatever key encrypts them. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:ebs-encrypted@1
- EBS volumes with `Encrypted` false are flagged and automatically encrypted. Encrypted volumes pass. HIGH, ORG. acme:ebs-encrypted@1
- EBS volumes with `Encrypted` false are flagged. Encrypted volumes, including those restored from an encrypted snapshot, pass. HIGH, ORG; detect-only, no action is taken. acme:ebs-encrypted@1
- EBS volumes with `Encrypted` false are flagged and encrypted in place. Encrypted volumes pass. HIGH, ORG; reports to the owner. acme:ebs-encrypted@1
- EBS volumes with `Encrypted` false are flagged, and the policy encrypts them. Encrypted volumes pass. HIGH, ORG. acme:ebs-encrypted@1
- EBS volumes with `Encrypted` true are flagged. Unencrypted volumes pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only. acme:ebs-encrypted@1
- EBS volumes with `Encrypted` false are flagged. Encrypted volumes pass. HIGH, ORG; reports only, then replaces the volume with an encrypted copy. acme:ebs-encrypted@1
